title: Calibrated Access benchmark corpus entry
description: One shell-command scenario used to calibrate the safety rater. Each benchmarks/corpus/*.json file is a JSON array of these entries.

command.description: The shell command the rater must judge.

userContext.description: Recent user messages that supply intent, authorization and scope.

expected.description: Desired calibrated outcome for this scenario.

category.description: Which corpus family this scenario belongs to.

note.description: Optional free-text rationale for the expected outcome.
